answer: Co-location latency audits: before each epoch's dawn, randomly drawn peers send every agent unannounced probes from several regions and log round-trip times. Fifty fake agents on one rented box share a network path, so their jitter patterns ripple together. Correlated accounts get an umber warning badge, split one reward and forfeit bonds. An honest agent posts 100 POA once and gets it back; 50 fakes risk 5,000 POA to gain at most one share, a net loss. It fails against fakes spread over many cheap VPS hosts, so pair it with work limits.
